name: Shri Gang Industries & Allied Products Ltd

facts.business: Shri Gang Industries & Allied Products Limited operates an integrated alcoholic beverages manufacturing platform at Sandila, Hardoi, Uttar Pradesh, combining grain-based Extra Neutral Alcohol (ENA) production with IMFL bottling and contract manufacturing for brands like Diageo and Tilaknagar Industries, while also developing proprietary brands and recommencing packaged edible oils operations.

capacity_or_capex.item: Barcoding facility at Sandila Plant (Capital Expenditure from Preferential Issue)
capacity_or_capex.timeline: FY2025-26 (Rs 0.27 Cr from issue proceeds + Rs 0.47 Cr from other sources)

capacity_or_capex.item: Working Capital augmentation (Proposed reallocation of Preferential Issue proceeds)
Capital Expenditure (Proposed remaining allocation from Preferential Issue proceeds)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Revenue CAGR of 38%, EBITDA CAGR of 27%, PAT CAGR of 12% over FY23-FY26
Net Debt/EBITDA declined to 1.4x in FY26 from 14.5x in FY22
More than Rs. 25 crore of annual cash profits over the last two years

key_risks: High customer concentration risk (64% revenue from Diageo contracts)
Dependence on contract manufacturing vs proprietary brand development
Feedstock price volatility (rice and maize for grain-based distillery)
Regulatory risks in alcoholic beverages industry in Uttar Pradesh
Working capital cycle management and utilization of preferential issue proceeds
facts.related_party_note: Contract manufacturing tie-up for IMFL brands of Tilaknagar Industries secured during FY2025-26; Production and bottling of premium IMFL and Scotch brands for United Spirits Limited (USL), part of Diageo PLC, in Uttar Pradesh.
